issues.description: The take/put axioms can return linear pointer permissions while leaving an equivalent copy stored in the original PointsTo object, allowing tracked ownership to be duplicated or replaced without a borrow relationship.
issues.rationale: In the base, `take_inner_perms(&mut self)` returns a tracked value equal to `old(self).inner_perms`, but its postcondition also leaves the enclosing object's address and points-to state unchanged and does not consume or invalidate `final(self).inner_perms`. `take_points_to` has the same problem for the underlying linear points-to permission, while `put_inner_perms` can replace the field axiomatically. These contracts can therefore manufacture an independently owned permission equal to one still retained in `self`, defeating the exclusivity that the tracked resource is meant to enforce. The collaborator explicitly identifies these helpers as unsound and requests replacement with new mutable-reference support; the final commit removes the take/put axioms and exposes mutable borrows whose postconditions tie the returned reference to the corresponding final field. A second collaborator confirms that replacing the axioms with borrows is the correct direction.
issues.source_evidence:
before/vstd_extra/src/cast_ptr.rs
243: pub axiom fn take_inner_perms(tracked &mut self) -> (tracked result: T::Perm)
245:     result == old(self).inner_perms,
246-247: final(self) retains the same address and points_to
250: pub axiom fn put_inner_perms(...)
257: pub axiom fn take_points_to(...)
259:             result == old(self).points_to,

after/vstd_extra/src/cast_ptr.rs
259: pub proof fn borrow_mut_inner_perms(...) -> (tracked result: &mut T::Perm)
264:             final(self).inner_perms == *final(result),
271: pub proof fn borrow_mut_points_to(...) -> (tracked result: &mut simple_pptr::PointsTo<R>)
275:             final(self).points_to == *final(result),
issues.verification: source-only; historical Rust and Verus were not executed. Checked the complete archived and live discussion, all eight official PR commits, the exact fixed base/head objects, the unsound base axiom postconditions, the final borrow-based replacement, and the absence of the take/put helpers in the fixed tree.
